policies.title: Turkmen ordinary passports: Grenada visa at arrival
policies.summary: Grenada's live-linked schedule marks Turkmenistan Port of Entry.
conditions: Ordinary Turkmen passport; short visitor only.
Grenada defines Port of Entry as visa granted on arrival.
Other purposes and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Turkmen ordinary passports: Panama authorized visa
policies.summary: Panama names Turkmenistan in its authorized-visa cohort.
conditions: Ordinary Turkmen passport; short visitor without Panama's separate third-country-document waiver.
In-person consular application; approval may take up to 60 business days.

policies.title: Turkmen ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's Tourism Board table maps Turkmenistan to visa on arrival.
conditions: Ordinary Turkmen passport; short visitor only.
Register for Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry point and final admission remain governed by Jordanian authorities.

conflicts.explanation: Grenada's live Embassy-linked nationality schedule explicitly classifies Turkmenistan as Port of Entry, defined as a visa granted on arrival.
